title: Grilled Mediterranean Chicken Thighs with Olive‑Tomato Salsa
description: Herb‑marinated thighs grilled then topped with a vibrant olive and tomato salsa.
instructions: Marinate thighs 4–12 h in oil, brine, garlic, herbs.
Grill on medium heat skin‑side up first, then flip until internal temp reaches 165 °F.
Let rest, then top with chopped olive‑tomato salsa.

title: Grilled Mediterranean Chicken Kebabs
description: Cubed chicken and vegetables threaded on skewers after marinating in lemon‑garlic herbs.
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano
instructions: Marinate chicken and veggies 1‑4 h.
Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill 5‑6 min per side until cooked through.

title: Healthy Grilled Mediterranean Chicken Kabobs
description: Chicken and garden veggies marinated in lemon‑oregano garlic oil, skewered and grilled juicy.
ingredients: Zucchini, bell pepper, red onion, cherry tomatoes
Olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano
instructions: Marinate 30 min to 4 h.
Assemble skewers alternating chicken with veggies.
Brush reserved marinade and grill 5‑6 min each side.

title: Grilled Lemon Herb Mediterranean Chicken Salad
description: Grilled chicken served over salad greens with olives, tomato, cucumber and herb‑lemon dressing.
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon juice, red wine vinegar
Parsley, basil, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper
instructions: Whisk marinade; marinate chicken 15 min–2 h.
Grill chicken until done; let rest, then slice.
Toss salad greens with remaining marinade, top with chicken.

title: Spicy Harissa Grilled Chicken Breasts
description: Zesty and smoky harissa‑marinated chicken breasts grilled rapidly for bold flavor.
instructions: Combine marinade and marinate chicken at least 30 min.
Grill 5‑7 min per side until 165 °F.
Let rest, garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Mediterranean‑Inspired Spicy Grilled Chicken (Legs)
description: Chicken legs marinated in ginger‑garlic and chili paste, grilled or oven‑baked for spicy kick.
ingredients: Roasted red chili paste, ginger‑garlic paste
Onion powder, chili flakes, cumin, oregano, parsley
instructions: Marinate at least 3‑4 h or overnight.
Grill or bake at 425 °F about 20‑25 min until done.
Serve with tabbouleh or pita.

title: Whole Grilled Mediterranean‑Style Chicken
description: Whole chicken marinated in lemon‑garlic herbs, grilled indirect for crispy skin and succulent meat.
ingredients: Garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, herbs
instructions: Marinate 2 h or more in garlic‑citrus herb mix.
Grill indirect heat 1 h until skin crispy and internal temp reached.
Carve and serve with sauce and sides.

title: Mediterranean Chicken Skewers with Yogurt Marinade
description: Chicken thighs marinated in yogurt‑spice mix then skewered and grilled Mediterranean‑style.
ingredients: Greek yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil
instructions: Mix yogurt‑spice marinade; coat chicken and refrigerate 1+ h.
Thread onto skewers; grill turning until golden and cooked.
Serve hot with sides.

title: Lemon Herb Mediterranean Chicken Breasts
description: Classic lemon‑garlic herb marinade grilled chicken breasts—juicy and fragrant.
ingredients: Garlic, fresh rosemary, thyme, salt, pepper
instructions: Whisk marinade; marinate at least 30 min.
Grill 6‑7 min each side until cooked.
Let rest, then slice and serve.

title: Sheet‑Pan Mediterranean Chicken with Vegetables
description: Chicken thighs roasted with tomatoes, gnocchi, veggies and Mediterranean seasonings on one pan.
instructions: Toss ingredients on sheet pan, season well.
Roast at 425 °F 20‑25 min until chicken cooked and vegetables tender.
Serve warm.

title: Grilled Chicken Thighs with Dill-Greek Yogurt Sauce
description: Juicy grilled thighs paired with tangy dill‑Greek yogurt sauce.
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, dill
Greek yogurt, fresh dill, lemon zest, salt
instructions: Marinate thighs 1–2 h in oil, lemon, garlic, herbs.
Grill 7–10 min until 165 °F internal temp.
Mix yogurt sauce; serve chicken topped with sauce.

title: Greek‑Style Chicken Kabobs with Lemon-Herb Marinade
description: Chicken and veggies skewered with fresh lemon‑garlic marinade.
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, oregano, garlic
instructions: Marinate chicken & veggies 30–60 min.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill 5–6 min per side; brush with reserved marinade.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Chicken Breasts
description: Bright lemon‑garlic herb grilled breasts—simple, flavorful, classic.
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon juice, parsley, garlic, paprika, oregano
instructions: Marinate 20 min to 2 h.
Grill 5–7 min per side.
Rest then serve with lemon wedges.

title: Grilled Chicken with Olive & Tomato Salsa
description: Herbed thighs grilled then topped with chunky olive‑tomato salsa.
ingredients: Olive oil, brine, anchovy paste, herbs, garlic
Salsa: olives, tomatoes, shallot, capers, herbs
instructions: Marinate 4‑12 h.
Grill thighs skin‑side up then down until crisp.
Serve topped with olive‑tomato salsa.

title: Cucumber‑Yogurt Marinated Grilled Chicken
description: Chicken marinated in olive oil, vinegar, garlic and dill, served with cucumber‑yogurt sauce.
ingredients: Olive oil, red wine vinegar, garlic, dill
instructions: Marinate chicken ≥2 h.
Grill until cooked through.
Prepare cucumber‑yogurt sauce; serve on side.

title: Spicy Harissa Grilled Chicken Breasts
description: Bold and smoky harissa‑spiced chicken grilled quickly for heat and flavor.
ingredients: Harissa paste, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cilantro
instructions: Marinate ≥30 min.
Grill 5–7 min per side.
Garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Lemony Marinated Chicken Skewers
description: Bright, citrusy Mediterranean‑Middle Eastern skewers with herbs and spices.
ingredients: Lemon juice, garlic, herbs, spices (optional cayenne)
instructions: Marinate 30 min.
Thread onto skewers; grill until done.
Serve with toum or yogurt sauce.

title: Tahini‑Sauced Chicken Skewers with Chickpeas & Feta
description: Skewered grilled chicken served with tahini sauce, spicy chickpeas and feta-laced salad.
ingredients: Greek yogurt, garlic, lemon, paprika, oregano
instructions: Marinate and grill chicken.
Serve with spiced chickpeas, tahini sauce and pita salad.

title: Whole Grilled Chicken with Lemon‑Garlic‑Herbs
description: Butterflied whole chicken marinated and grilled indirectly for crispy skin & moist meat.
ingredients: Whole chicken, garlic, olive oil, lemon, herbs
Sides: grilled veggies, toum or yogurt sauce
instructions: Marinate 2+ h.
Grill indirect for 60 min or until done.
Carve and serve with sides.

title: Grilled Chicken Wings with Mediterranean Spices & Yogurt Dip
description: Flavorful wings marinated in spices, grilled until crisp, served with yogurt dip and salad.
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, cumin, paprika, cayenne
Yogurt, tahini, tomatoes, cucumber, parsley, mint
instructions: Marinate wings 1–2 h.
Grill crowded for 20 min, turning every 5 min.
Mix salad and yogurt‑tahini dip; serve together.
